items.title: 24.2.1 Mechanism of Evolution - Natural Selection (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 24.2.1 and the Wallace box, printed pages 217-218.

blocks.text: Evolution ke jadeed nazariye ke bani (founder) Charles Darwin (1809 – 1882) the. 1859 mein unhon ne apni kitab “On the Origin of Species” shaya ki. Is kitab mein unhon ne kaha ke evolution jandaron mein variations (farq) aur natural selection (qudrati intikhab) ke zariye hota hai. Un ke nazariye ka khulasa yeh hai:

items: Overproduction (zaroorat se zyada paidaish): Har jandar jitne bachche paida kar sakta hai, utne kabhi asal mein zinda nahin rehte. Maslan ek maada sea star har mausam mein taqreeban 10 lakh (1 million) ande deti hai. Socheein agar yeh sab ande fertilize ho kar agle saal tak bachche dene ke qabil ban jayen? Aadhe ande maada aur aadhe nar banenge, yaani 5 lakh maada sea stars; har ek phir 10 lakh ande degi. Yeh sirf chand naslon tak chale to samandar sea stars se bhar jayen!

Variations (farq): Genetic farq ittefaqi (random) mutations se paida hote hain. Do afraad shayad hi kabhi bilkul ek jaise hote hain. Yeh genetic farq faida-mand (advantageous), nuqsan-deh (harmful) ya neutral (na faida na nuqsan) ho sakte hain. Jo farq virasat (inheritance) mein aate hain woh bachchon mein muntaqil ho sakte hain.

Struggle for survival (zinda rehne ki jad-o-jehad): Kyun ke wasail (resources) jitne bachchon ko pal sakte hain us se kahin zyada bachche paida hote hain, is liye afraad ko zinda rehne ke liye muqabla karna parta hai. Nuqsan-deh farq wale afraad mar jate hain ya nasl nahin barha pate. Faida-mand farq wale afraad kamyabi se nasl barhate hain. Aise farq ko adaptive traits (mahol ke mutabiq faida-mand khasiyatein) kehte hain.

Inheritance of adaptive traits (adaptive traits ki virasat): Adaptive traits agli naslon mein muntaqil hote hain. Kyun ke nuqsan-deh khasiyaton wale jandar kam nasl barhate hain, is liye aisi khasiyatein population mein kam hoti jati hain aur aakhir khatam ho jati hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar khaane: 1 Overproduction (bohat se aik jaise surmai jandar), 2 Variations (gehre, halke aur peele hare rang ke farq), 3 Struggle for survival (halke rang wale kaate hue: mar gaye ya nasl na barha sake), 4 Inheritance of adaptive traits (agli nasl mein sirf gehre hare). Khaanon ke darmiyan teer.
blocks.caption: Natural selection ke chaar nukte (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.title: Alfred Russel Wallace
blocks.text: Alfred R. Wallace (1823 – 1913) ek British naturalist aur biologist the jinhon ne evolution ke tareeqe (mechanism) par apna alag nazariya banaya. 1858 mein unhon ne Darwin ko ek khat likha. Wallace ke khat mein evolution ka jo tareeqa bataya gaya tha woh Darwin ke nazariye se bohat milta tha. Jab 1858 mein Darwin aur Wallace dono ke nazariyat Linnean Society mein pesh kiye gaye to Wallace ne mann liya ke yeh nazariya Darwin ke naam se jana jaye. Unhon ne Darwin ko apni kitab “On the Origin of Species” shaya karne par bhi amada kiya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein Wallace ke khat ka saal 1957 chhapa hai. Yeh mumkin nahin: Wallace 1823 se 1913 tak zinda rahe. Sahi saal 1858 hai, jab dono nazariyat Linnean Society mein pesh hue.

blocks.prompt: Qudrat mein ‘struggle for survival’ (zinda rehne ki jad-o-jehad) kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke jandar dastiyab khuraak, jagah aur doosre wasail se kahin zyada bachche paida karte hain, is liye sab zinda nahin reh sakte; un mein muqabla hota hai aur faida-mand farq wale zyada bachte hain.

items: Darwin ne 1859 mein “On the Origin of Species” mein natural selection ka nazariya diya.
Chaar nukte: overproduction, variations, struggle for survival, adaptive traits ki virasat.
Wallace ne bhi aisa hi nazariya banaya; 1858 mein dono Linnean Society mein pesh hue aur nazariya Darwin ke naam hua.
